visualCharacteristics.purpose: Find a Branch or ATM search card over a map image; the shadow option is a text-only teaser card overlapping a photo

contentPattern.structure: Optional picture-only row: background map/photo. Text rows: heading, subtitle and extra links (e.g. Advanced Search Options) shown in the card in authored order. Form row: last cell is a single link (href = locator URL, text = button label), the cell before it is the search field label, and an optional earlier cell holds a choice group (legend line plus list or comma-separated choices such as Branches, ATM) rendered as radio buttons. The form POSTs to the locator URL: search-only sends q, lang, searchBranch, searchATM; with a choice group it sends location_type (BRANCH/ABM) and postal

reuseGuidance: Use for the branch/ATM locator search panel. Leave out the form row for a text card over a photo (shadow option).
